race.title: Citipost Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Despite losing his unbeaten record over fences, LITTLE LEDGEND emerged with plenty of credit when third in a similar amateur riders' handicap over C&D 3 weeks ago. In a change of headgear he's marginally preferred to Herakles Westwood and Transmission , both of whom have previous in this race. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE) HERAKLES WESTWOOD (FR) TRANSMISSION (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Little Ledgend (4/1), Herakles Westwood (9/2), Transmission (11/2), Karnaval Point (11/2), Dinoland (13/2), Our Soldier (15/2), Jaccours (8/1), Ladies Well (11/1), Sound And Fury (11/1), Brucejack (14/1), Awaythelad (25/1), Top Guy (25/1)
